# ui-design

## Do
Build the simplest UI that fulfills its purpose. Use whitespace, alignment and typography to show the importance and relationships of information. Keep a concise color palette and use color to distinguish primary actions and meaningful states. Follow the user's direction and the existing product design, expressing elements with the same role consistently. Make actions and their results easy to understand, and use motion to communicate interaction and state changes.

## Check
Inspect the rendered screen and interactions for unnecessary complexity, unclear information hierarchy, colors without a clear role, inconsistencies and confusing behavior. Point to each issue and explain the difficulty it causes the user.
